name: sbrain
description: Git-authoritative development kernel: session protocols, task ledger, memory, enforcement hooks, fresh-context code review, and stack profiles (NestJS backend, Vue admin-dashboard frontend on Tailwind + shadcn-vue via MCP, with LDAP/breakglass auth, MinIO storage, and RBAC concern rules). Git is the source of truth; every state file is a cache reconciled against it.
